test_description: Regularization / prior strength — test lambda=0, lambda>0, lambda<0, NaN, and inspect whether HistogramLBFGSSolver honors caller prior_lambda_
input_contract: prior_lambda_ >= 0 finite; negative/NaN rejected; caller-configured lambda respected or contract discrepancy documented

expected.lambda_contract: Reject negative/NaN lambda and preserve configured prior_lambda_

actual.lambda_contract: Negative lambda=-5.0 accepted, NaN lambda->NLL=NaN, and fit_histogram overwrote caller lambda=2.5 to 0.040000

assertion_notes: CONTRACT MISMATCH: HistogramLBFGSSolver::fit_histogram (lbfgs_solver.cpp:107) unconditionally overwrites `model.prior_lambda_ = 0.04`, discarding caller-configured lambda=2.5 and schema lambda=0.5!
